contract.goal: Implement parseDuration(text) in src/duration.mjs. It converts strings made of number+unit parts, with units h, m and s, into a total number of seconds: '1h30m' is 5400, '45s' is 45, '2m10s' is 130. Parts may appear in any order but each unit at most once. Anything else (empty string, unknown unit, repeated unit, stray characters, a missing number) must throw a TypeError.
